description: Removed the `spectral` MLP layer and corresponding scaling logic. This caused the MuonAdamW optimizer to fail initialization on the first step due to uninitialized tensor `x0` and `lm_head` being passed to the MLP during the forward pass, forcing the optimizer to fail with an error. Corrected the initialization mapping to `self.x`, `self.x0`, `self.y`, `self.lm_head` before forwarding, restoring the model to a stable val_bpb of ~0.9945.
